description_full: Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates drugstores in Japan. The company also provides self-care support services, including meal delivery, cancer and other health checkups, specific health guidance, health information, and community comprehensive agreements; home-visit dispensing and nursing, prevention programs, shopping assistance, and mobility support services. In addition, it engages in drugstore operation, dispensing pharmacy operation, medical consultation, business in foreign countries, Chinese medicine pharmacy operations, disease prevention and health support, promotion of disabled employment, home visit nursing and elderly home-care support, support for commencement of medical practice, comprehensive staff agency service, and support business for pharmacy operations. Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Obu, Japan.

financial_summary: SUGI HLDGS CO LTD is a mid-cap healthcare business with a $3.0B market cap on $6.4B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +11% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 14% against a 9% cost of capital, a 6-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it, with gross margins sitting at 31%.

The business throws off $385M in free cash flow — roughly 6 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.93× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 55× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield is only 1.3%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 39% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
